93 likes, 15 comments - kateodonnell.ayurveda on August 19, 2026: "Perfectionism disguised as wellness. @nidhisunil calls a spade a spade.

Vogue India's Model of the Year, the first Indian face of L'Oréal and women’s advocate @nidhisunil calls out some BS in this episode. There is so much I never knew about the modeling industry. 

This week Nidhi Sunil joins me for one of the most honest conversations we've had on this show — about burnout, self-worth, and the slow work of coming back to yourself. It started, of all places, with a bowl of kitchari.

And a shout out to this season’s sponsors @drtungs, @banyanbotanicals, and @banyanfarmlife for helping us get important information like this out there!

Listen to the pod Everyday Ayurveda with Kate wherever you get your podcasts. Please subscribe, review, and help me keep producing these.

#Ayurveda #Burnout #SelfWorth #AyurvedicLiving #NervousSystemHealth #Ojas".
